description: Documented exclusions for scripts/check_sdk_coverage.py (issue #556). Each entry states why one operationId is intentionally absent from one SDK surface. The CI gate fails when an allowlisted operation becomes implemented (stale entry) or when an entry references an unknown operationId. Never add an entry just to silence a regression - implement the method or record a concrete architectural reason.
note_go_client: packages/go-client is regenerated from docs/openapi.yaml and pinned by the go-client-stale CI job, so name coverage there is already enforced.
